```{r}
# Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(orchaRd)
library(janitor)
library(here)
library(alluvial)
library(ggalluvial)
```


```{r}
#| label: read-data
#| message: false
#| warning: false

dat_raw <- readr::read_csv(
  here::here("data", "PROCEEDv6.2_RatesDB.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  janitor::clean_names()

glimpse(dat_raw)
```





```{r}
#| label: prep-id-data-full
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# Full dataset, only the grouping variables of interest
# Set keep_missing = TRUE if you want missing IDs treated as levels
keep_missing <- FALSE

dat_ids <- dat_raw |>
  transmute(
    ref_id  = ref_id,
    sys_id  = sys_id,
    sp_ncbi = sp_ncbi
  )

if (keep_missing) {
  dat_ids <- dat_ids |>
    mutate(
      across(
        everything(),
        ~ dplyr::coalesce(na_if(.x, ""), "Missing")
      )
    )
} else {
  dat_ids <- dat_ids |>
    filter(
      !is.na(ref_id),  ref_id  != "",
      !is.na(sys_id),  sys_id  != "",
      !is.na(sp_ncbi), sp_ncbi != ""
    )
}

dat_ids <- dat_ids |>
  mutate(
    ref_id  = factor(ref_id),
    sys_id  = factor(sys_id),
    sp_ncbi = factor(sp_ncbi)
  ) |>
  droplevels()

dat_ids |>
  summarise(
    k_rows     = n(),
    n_ref_id   = n_distinct(ref_id),
    n_sys_id   = n_distinct(sys_id),
    n_sp_ncbi  = n_distinct(sp_ncbi)
  )
```








```{r}
#| label: compact-support-table-final
#| message: false
#| warning: false

make_link_summary <- function(data, grouping_factor, linked_factor, relationship_label) {
  data |>
    distinct(.data[[grouping_factor]], .data[[linked_factor]]) |>
    count(.data[[grouping_factor]], name = "n_matches") |>
    summarise(
      Group = grouping_factor,
      Relationship = relationship_label,
      `Groups with only one match` = sum(n_matches == 1),
      `Total groups` = n(),
      `Only one match (%)` = round(100 * mean(n_matches == 1), 1)
    )
}

support_table <- bind_rows(
  make_link_summary(
    dat_ids,
    grouping_factor = "sp_ncbi",
    linked_factor = "sys_id",
    relationship_label = "systems per species"
  ),
  make_link_summary(
    dat_ids,
    grouping_factor = "sys_id",
    linked_factor = "sp_ncbi",
    relationship_label = "species per system"
  ),
  make_link_summary(
    dat_ids,
    grouping_factor = "ref_id",
    linked_factor = "sys_id",
    relationship_label = "systems per reference"
  ),
  make_link_summary(
    dat_ids,
    grouping_factor = "sys_id",
    linked_factor = "ref_id",
    relationship_label = "references per system"
  )
) |>
  mutate(
    Group = dplyr::recode(
      Group,
      sp_ncbi = "Species",
      sys_id  = "System",
      ref_id  = "Reference"
    )
  )

support_table
```
